description: SR2026 CBPR+ pacs.008 FIToFICstmrCdtTrf validation rules — production-ready, authoritative definition for all validation layers

bizSvc.description: BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.04' for pacs.008 in SR2026 (changed from 'swift.cbprplus.02' in SR2025).
bizSvc.errorMessage: AppHdr <BizSvc> must be 'swift.cbprplus.04' for pacs.008 in SR2026.

msgDefIdr.description: MsgDefIdr must be exactly 'pacs.008.001.08' — enforced strictly in SR2026 (not just a recommendation).
msgDefIdr.errorMessage: AppHdr <MsgDefIdr> must be 'pacs.008.001.08' for pacs.008 in SR2026.

bizMsgIdr.description: BizMsgIdr is now typed as RestrictedFINXMax35Text in SR2026, allowing only the SWIFT FIN character set.
bizMsgIdr.errorMessage: AppHdr <BizMsgIdr> must conform to RestrictedFINXMax35Text: 1-35 chars, only 0-9 a-z A-Z / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space.
bizMsgIdr.fix: Remove unsupported characters and ensure length is between 1 and 35.

namespaceValidation.description: XML namespace must match pacs.008.001.08 for SR2026 validation.

groupHeader.description: Mandatory fields in the Group Header block

MsgId.description: Group Header Message ID is mandatory.

CreDtTm.description: Creation Date Time is mandatory in Group Header.

NbOfTxs.description: Number of Transactions is mandatory and must equal the actual count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks.
NbOfTxs.fix: Add <NbOfTxs> with the count of transactions.

SttlmInf.description: Settlement Information is mandatory in Group Header.

transactionBlock.description: Mandatory fields in each CdtTrfTxInf transaction block

PmtId.EndToEndId.description: EndToEndId is mandatory and cannot be blank. Use 'NOTPROVIDED' when not available.
PmtId.EndToEndId.fix: Set <EndToEndId> to 'NOTPROVIDED' or a valid identification string.

PmtId.UETR.description: UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) is mandatory in pacs.008 under CBPR+.
PmtId.UETR.fix: Add a valid UUID v4 to <PmtId><UETR> (e.g., 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267).

InstdAmt.description: Instructed Amount becomes mandatory in SR2026 for pacs.008 (was optional in SR2025).

ChrgBr.fix: Add <ChrgBr> with one of: SLEV, SHAR, CRED, DEBT.

Dbtr.description: Debtor party is mandatory in pacs.008.

DbtrAcct.description: Debtor Account is mandatory in pacs.008.

Cdtr.description: Creditor party is mandatory in pacs.008.

CdtrAcct.description: Creditor Account is mandatory in pacs.008.

addressRules.description: SR2026 deprecates all unstructured AdrLine elements in postal addresses. Only structured addresses (TwnNm + Ctry minimum) are allowed.

GracePeriod_Hybrid.description: Hybrid address mode (AdrLine + TwnNm + Ctry) — grace period expired in SR2026.

GracePeriod_Structured.description: Structured mode (no AdrLine, but TwnNm and Ctry optional) — grace period expired in SR2026.

GracePeriod_Unstructured.description: Unstructured mode (AdrLine only) — grace period expired in SR2026.

adrLineDeprecated.description: AdrLine is deprecated in SR2026. Use structured elements: StrtNm, BldgNb, PstCd, TwnNm, Ctry.
adrLineDeprecated.errorMessage: Postal address contains unstructured <AdrLine> element(s) which are deprecated in SR2026.

townName.errorMessage: Debtor Postal Address is missing mandatory <TwnNm> (Town Name) in SR2026.

country.errorMessage: Debtor Postal Address is missing mandatory <Ctry> (Country) in SR2026.
country.fix: Add <Ctry> with a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

townName.errorMessage: Creditor Postal Address is missing mandatory <TwnNm> (Town Name) in SR2026.

country.errorMessage: Creditor Postal Address is missing mandatory <Ctry> (Country) in SR2026.
country.fix: Add <Ctry> with a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

proxyRules.description: When a Proxy element is present, the Proxy Type (Tp) sub-element becomes mandatory in SR2026.
proxyRules.errorMessage: Proxy Type <Tp> is mandatory inside <Prxy> when Proxy is present in SR2026.

serviceLevelRules.description: GPI Service Level restrictions in SR2026.
serviceLevelRules.errorMessage: GPI Service Level code is not allowed in SR2026. Only 'G001' is permitted.
serviceLevelRules.fix: Use 'G001' or a valid non-GPI service level code.

dateRules.description: Date fields in SR2026 must use CBPR_Date format (YYYY-MM-DD only). Timezone offsets are not allowed.
dateRules.errorMessage: Date field contains timezone offset which is not allowed in SR2026. Use YYYY-MM-DD format without timezone.
dateRules.fix: Remove timezone offset from date fields (e.g. change '2026-11-20Z' to '2026-11-20').

validationRules.description: Additional business rule validations specific to SR2026.

rules.errorMessage: AppHdr <BizSvc> must be 'swift.cbprplus.04' for pacs.008 in SR2026.
AppHdr <MsgDefIdr> must be 'pacs.008.001.08' for pacs.008 in SR2026.

rules.validation: len(BizMsgIdr) between 1 and 35 AND only allowed chars
rules.errorMessage: AppHdr <BizMsgIdr> must conform to RestrictedFINXMax35Text (1-35 chars, SWIFT character set).
rules.fix: Remove unsupported characters. Allowed: 0-9 a-z A-Z / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space.

rules.description: AppHdr BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr MsgId — new consistency rule in SR2026
rules.errorMessage: AppHdr Business Message ID <BizMsgIdr> must equal Group Header Message ID <MsgId>.
rules.fix: Align <BizMsgIdr> in AppHdr with <MsgId> in GrpHdr.

rules.description: AppHdr From BIC must match Instructing Agent BIC
rules.condition: Both AppHdr Fr.BICFI and InstgAgt.BICFI present
rules.normalization: Pad 8-char BIC to 11 chars with 'XXX' suffix
rules.fix: Ensure AppHdr From BIC matches Instructing Agent BIC.

rules.description: AppHdr To BIC must match Instructed Agent BIC (except CopyDuplicate)
rules.condition: Both AppHdr To.BICFI and InstdAgt.BICFI present AND CpyDplct is not COPY/CODU
rules.normalization: Pad 8-char BIC to 11 chars with 'XXX' suffix
rules.errorMessage: AppHdr <To> BICFI must match <InstdAgt> BICFI (unless CpyDplct is COPY or CODU).
rules.fix: Ensure AppHdr To BIC matches Instructed Agent BIC.

rules.description: Instructed Amount is mandatory in SR2026
rules.errorMessage: Instructed Amount <InstdAmt> is mandatory in SR2026.

rules.description: AdrLine is deprecated — only structured addresses allowed in SR2026
rules.errorMessage: Postal address contains unstructured <AdrLine> which is deprecated in SR2026.

rules.description: Debtor postal address must have TwnNm and Ctry
rules.validation: Dbtr.PstlAdr.TwnNm is present AND Dbtr.PstlAdr.Ctry is present
rules.errorMessage: Debtor Postal Address must include <TwnNm> and <Ctry> in SR2026.

rules.description: Creditor postal address must have TwnNm and Ctry
rules.validation: Cdtr.PstlAdr.TwnNm is present AND Cdtr.PstlAdr.Ctry is present
rules.errorMessage: Creditor Postal Address must include <TwnNm> and <Ctry> in SR2026.

rules.description: Proxy Type mandatory when Proxy is present
rules.errorMessage: Proxy Type <Tp> is mandatory inside <Prxy> when Proxy is present in SR2026.

rules.description: Only G001 is allowed as GPI service level code in SR2026
rules.errorMessage: GPI Service Level code is disallowed in SR2026. Only 'G001' is permitted.
rules.fix: Use 'G001' or a valid non-GPI service level code.

rules.description: Date fields must not contain timezone offsets (CBPR_Date format)
rules.condition: Any date-type field (ending in Dt, not DtTm) contains a value
rules.validation: Date value does not match pattern ending in Z or ±HH:MM
rules.errorMessage: Date field contains timezone offset which is not allowed in SR2026 CBPR_Date format.
rules.fix: Remove the timezone suffix (e.g. change '2026-11-20Z' to '2026-11-20').

rules.description: EndToEndId cannot be blank — use NOTPROVIDED
rules.errorMessage: End-to-End ID <EndToEndId> cannot be blank. Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if not applicable.
rules.fix: Set <EndToEndId> to 'NOTPROVIDED' or a valid end-to-end identification string.

rules.description: UETR mandatory in all CdtTrfTxInf blocks
rules.validation: CdtTrfTxInf.PmtId.UETR is present and matches UUID v4 pattern
rules.errorMessage: UETR is mandatory in pacs.008 under CBPR+ SR2026.
rules.fix: Add a valid UUID v4 to <PmtId><UETR>.

rules.description: Structured Remittance may not exceed 9000 business characters
rules.validation: Total leaf text content in Strd block <= 9000 characters
rules.errorMessage: Structured Remittance block exceeds maximum 9000 business characters.
rules.fix: Reduce the content inside <Strd> to within 9000 characters.

xmlGenerationRules.description: Default values used when generating SR2026-compliant pacs.008 XML.

uiRules.description: Field-level UI hints for the generator form when SR2026 is selected.

instructedAmount.hint: Instructed Amount is mandatory in SR2026

debtorTownName.hint: Town Name is required in Debtor Address (SR2026)

debtorCountry.hint: Country is required in Debtor Address (SR2026)

creditorTownName.hint: Town Name is required in Creditor Address (SR2026)

creditorCountry.hint: Country is required in Creditor Address (SR2026)

proxyType.hint: Proxy Type is mandatory when Proxy is present (SR2026)

endToEndId.hint: Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if End-to-End ID is not known (SR2026)

changesSinceSR2025.description: Summary of SR2026 changes from SR2025 for pacs.008 CBPR+

changes.impact: Breaking — must update all outbound messages
Breaking for any message using a different or missing value
Character set restricted to SWIFT FIN character set

changes.sr2026: Mandatory cross-field consistency rule — new ERROR
changes.impact: New rule — messages with mismatched IDs will fail
Breaking — must always include Instructed Amount

changes.sr2025: Allowed via grace periods (Hybrid, Unstructured, Structured modes)
changes.sr2026: Fully deprecated — ERROR for all parties
changes.impact: Breaking — must migrate all addresses to structured format
Breaking for messages using Proxy without Type
Breaking for any GPI codes other than G001
Breaking for any date containing timezone suffix
